rawContent: The bubble needs to burst. If anything, the movement has showed how not only women but men have been subjected to sexual abuse. #MeToo has actually united genders.
The fact that we put survivors in the dock and continue to buy the popular perception of the perpetrators  shows what's wrong with us when it comes to #MeToo.

This is what Bollywood megastar has to say on the most important story right now-Tanushree Dutta's #MeToo moment and the accused Nana Patekar- 

"Neither am I Tanushree, nor am I Nana Patekar, so how can I comment on this?"

We know how the rest of Bollywood going to respond. :)

Aamir Khan shows some spine. On Tanusuree's #MeToo moment:

"Whenever something like this happens, it is really a sad thing. If now this has happened, it is for the people to investigate, I don't want to comment on it."

While Tanushree answers media questions, her alleged perpetrator is making merry. :) That's the reality of sexual abuse in our country. That's the reality our women go through. That's why #MeToo is a failure in this country. https://t.co/Nagm3VL4z8
Finally, someone showed real spine and broke the silence. Not going to harp praise on Farhan because this should be the normal but really hope others take a cue from him and speak up. #MeToo

Men ARE scared. They are re-assesing their behaviour, recollecting all their engagements with different women. They are QUESTIONING their own actions. Oh, how much I waited for this to happen. #MeToo is here. #TimesUp
All assholes will go down. #MeToo
For all those making #MeToo movement in the country gender-specific, please read @kaneezsurka account.
FINALLY, Oshiwara police have registered FIR against veteran Nana Patekar, Ganesh Acharya, Horn Ok Pleasse producer Sami Siddhiqui and director Rakesh Sarang. More power to you #TanushreeDutta #metoo

There are a lot of scumbags in the television industry as well. Please, all you women and men working on television, reach out to me with your stories. You deserve to be heard and we all are in it together. #MeToo

This is the harrowing account by @whitespeaking of what @SimplySajidK actually did on the pretext of audition meeting

As she spoke to me, her words broke my heart a little and also fixed it. I hope they did the same to her. #MeToo #MetooIndia #TimesUp 

https://t.co/ZNvFJ6wtfG

The female filmmakers' support for #MeToo and #MeTooIndia movement is welcomed but I really need to know how does one "prove" molestation or harassment? Their letter says they won't work with proven offenders, but where do we get a proof of a man flashing at us?
Yeah, as if @mrsfunnybones and @akshaykumar had never known about despicable behaviour of @SimplySajidK. #MeToo #TimesUp

That is where predators get so much power from. Because they know the survivors don't have any evidence of the harassment, they can harass them repeatedly. It brings us down to the same question- How do we 'prove' we have been harasser? #MeToo #MeTooIndia
.@MallikaDua's statement more or less evoked empathy, even though I found the "IF" problematic. But her last line was so disappointing to read. #MeToo  #MeTooIndia

@MallikaDua As a daughter, you might not believe what #NishthaJain said but as an individual, who has shown unconditonal support to #MeToo movement, to say that you stand by the man, who is an accused, is defeating the movement itself.

@MallikaDua It's believable that you didn't know what your father did outside the house but you need to look at him beyond the lens of a daughter because only then will this movement really hold weight.  #MeToo #MeTooIndia

@MallikaDua It's when we break the shackles of personal, emotional interests is when we are able to contribute to the larger cause. If we don't show solidarity to survivors when reality hits home, we only enable the abusers. #MeToo #MeTooIndia

"But the normalcy of unreconstructed men will not return. The women of India will ensure it does not. It is the job of men to move from the sidelines and join the fight wholeheartedly." #MeToo
#TimesUp

Second woman accuses Soumik Sen of harassment. He chooses to maintain silence. Will #CheatIndia makers @emraanhashmi @itsBhushanKumar @EllipsisEntt take any action against him? #MeToo #MeTooIndia #TimesUp 

https://t.co/HnOMwhJN0V

To all my sisters, who stood together, and to all those men, who became our allies, @mjakbar  resignation is just the beginning. This is our victory. #MeToo 
#MeTooIndia #TimesUp

I see how these powerful abusers are trying to arm-twist media houses to not run #MeToo stories by throwing one defamation suit after the other. But they don't understand the power or a survivor's story. It will come out anyhow. #MeToo #MeTooIndia #TimesUp
It's baffling how there is not a single word by #CheatIndia team on the multiple allegations against @bangdu when they all are informed about them. #MeToo #MeTooIndia

There's a sense of pride that I know the journalists, who are doing some amazing work unearthing stories of #MeToo in the entertainment industry. Their passion and enthusiasm is infectious. #MeToo #MeTooIndia #TimesUp
Among the more popular names like #SajidKhan #NanaPatekar and #VikasBahl, @bangdu js quietly escaping the shame he rightly deserves. #MeToo #MeTooIndia

When his own producer @anubhavsinha confirms he pulled him up once for this, you know how much truth is there in the account of all these women against him. Just because he is a smaller name than other alleged abusers, doesn't mean one will overlook his wrongdoings. #MeToo

@aamir_khan @aanandlrai and others met PM to discuss how entertainment industry can contribute in nation building. Can PM please make a comment on the stories of blatant sexual harassment in the film industry? #MeTooIndia #MeToo https://t.co/p3A04xsj2z

What was your purpose? To hurt the movement in whatever little way you can? Himesh, this is such an abysmal piece. No wonder you quoted #Sanju because the way Hirani made mockery of the biopic genre, you attempted the same with the #Metoo movement.

We ask why women don't speak up about harassment? Look at the shoddy manner #IFTDA is handling @SimplySajidK case! Not only the survivors are not informed about the development, but they are being told the organisation's not answerable to them but the accused! Shameful. #MeToo

The four women, who showed the courage to recount those horrific incidents with @SimplySajidK, didn't ask #IFTDA for help. #IFTDA approached them on its own. So, why are they made to feel this is some kind of favour?! #MeToo

Loved what Aamir said on #metoo on #KoffeeWithKaran. Was just wondering why did Karan have to dumb Alia, Deepika, Ranveer and Akshay down so much! Similar questions and treatment could have been met to the other stars as well.
This BS doesn't get old. Consent is consent irrespective of the place and the power of the person misusing it. If someone forces him/herself on his/her partner, it's #MeToo. Period.
